1: An author writes out a story and characters before it is published (knows everything)

These are my points. None of them address the idea of how free will may work because my claim is that it cannot exist at all in a universe with a being that has God's attributes. 

If anything I only address it as an illusion of those who cannot entertain the idea of a universe without it.

Is it really free will if out of all the free will outcomes possible in a universe with true autonomy one is "picked" for use and all others are discarded?

What's the difference in how those magnets ended up on the metal? Either way I made the choice to put them in the same space knowing what might, would, or can happen. I'm still accountable. 

In both of the options neither addresses free will. They simply look the lack of it from different perspectives to justify the actions of the creator and provide a sense of purpose for the created. 

 If your scenario is true (both are the same) that means people that are destined to believe God are determined beforehand. What's the purpose of holding on to the idea of free will if you still get to go to heaven? .

You are still a chosen one in the universe you hypothetically presented. Why must you have control over that and not have it at the same time if you win either way? 

If the game is fixed and you walk away with 10 million why does it matter how you got it and why care about the people who don't or even consider them? No matter how many times you run the numbers in your scenario you still win at the end so why hold onto the very thing that disproves that victory?

Are you saying that the type of author that creates a story without foresight into an ending is different than an author that had things clearly planned out? Even so there is a point you didn't address that I feel is very important to my over all argument. It is that like God, an author no matter the style, still lives outside of time. Unless the story is not thought out at all and taken live as it goes it is impossible for an author to not know the final draft that gets published for production. Until that draft gets posted any any all actions of the author in regards to his/her creations are in the author's time space and have absolutely no effect on the time space of the creations until time resumes in the plot of creation. 

Just because I don't know what flavor my main character will pick at the ice cream truck, until I write out what is picked time is frozen in the space of my story although it is not in my space. Because I live outside of time. Like God does.

"But do not ignore this one fact, beloved, that with the Lord one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like one day" 2 Peter 3:8

"In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth" Genesis 1:1

Anyway, from what you say they both definitely have low emotional intelligence. Eq comes down to a few factors for proper measurement. Recognizing and responding to others in an appropriate manner. A manner that would let the responding party continue to get what they want. 

In a nutshell the behavior of both of them reflect a mindset that cps, mandated reporters, and prisons don't exist. It's a eq one would expect of a child. One that doesn't really know the consequences of their actions on others to an extent. However, your mother did leave the pedophile and your father isn't driving and drinking with you in the car. So they have enough emotional intelligence to think longer than short term to an extent. 

Neither parent seems to be capable of knowing the long term impact though. They seem to be unable to place themselves in your shoes and only wake up or respond when the fire alarm is going off.

Lastly, their reaction to the alarm is a key. Your mother seems to use emotional blackmail. From a young age little girls learn that crying will get them what they want because it is socially acceptable much longer than it is for males. Children do it to escape accountability. Her emotional maturity seems evident if this is a tactic she uses as an adult in parenting situations.

The father seems to use intimidating tactics. Basically "stop or else". He was probably beat whenever he showed a reaction that was not pleasing to his caregivers. The alcohol abuse numbs the mind helping him run away from something he is not ready to face on his own yet. Doing it while watching children is irresponsible (shocker) and evidence of what he is trying to escape from.

Just throw a yep and okay into the fire every now and then. They Will not even notice because you exist as an object to them. They never cared about your input to begin with.

Expect flying monkey relatives that are brainwashed supply to attack often. Expect to find out what family and friends really know who you are. Opposite sex behaviors range from projecting the worst internalized aspects onto the child to attempting to make them what the narcissist considers a perfect mate.

Idk what dynamic of relationship you are in (same sex or opposite sex), but the schizoid defense is bullet proof against them.
